content: shadcn/ui (Tailwind CSS v4, Radix primitives, copy-paste ownership model) is the 2024-2026 de facto standard for teams that want full visual control and are judged on design polish -- exactly the 'this frontend IS the sales pitch' requirement. Mantine ships more batteries-included complex components (data tables, date pickers) faster but trades away full styling control; better fit for internal tools where visual differentiation matters less.
